I suddenly remember that a colleague gave 
me a coupon for a haunted house. Maybe 
it'll serve as a nice change of pace.

check it out?

not worry.

text_block_list.text:

forward.

somewhere in this room...

text_block_list.text:

all, there was no telling what kind of
